sections.name: Current Installment
sections.messageText: Select the installment(s) you wish to pay from the Payment Options column and then click Add to Cart at the bottom of the grid.

sections.name: VAB Bills
sections.messageText:
Value Adjustment Board "VAB" Message: This bill is under VAB review

OPTION 1 - Pay the bill 100% - click ADD TO CART
OPTION 2 - Pay 75% Ad Valorem and 100% Non-Ad Valorem Taxes - click the Under VAB Review link for amount due and then click ADD TO CART

Installment Payments - OPTION 2 installment payment may not be paid online. Current bill can be found under "View Info" and "Download your tax bill" showing other payment options, amount, and due dates. 

Payment is required to avoid denial of your petition and maintain VAB status (Section 194.014, F.S.). For additional information, please review www.pbctax.gov or contact the Tax Collector Office at 561-355-2264 or ClientAdvocate@pbctax.com.

sections.name: VAB Certified
sections.messageText:
Value Adjustment Board "VAB" Message: VAB payments are now due by June 20, 2026.

Any remaining balances become delinquent on June 21, 2026 and interest will begin to accrue.

For additional information, please review www.pbctax.gov or contact the Tax Collector Office at 561-355-2264 or ClientAdvocate@pbctax.com.

sections.name: Delinquent Year Bills
sections.messageText: IMPORTANT: Prior to making your payment for delinquent property taxes, please contact our office at 561-355-2264 to confirm the payoff amount, as the amount displayed online may not be accurate as additional fees may not be included in the amount shown online.

sections.name: Recently Paid Bills
sections.messageText:
Property taxes become delinquent April 1. Florida Statute, Chapter 197.432, mandates Tax Collectors hold an annual Tax Certificate Sale of delinquent taxes to make up for uncollected revenue.

Certificate = Unpaid certificate (AMOUNT DUE) indicates a tax lien exists. Within two tax years this property may be sold at auction to collect unpaid taxes. Click on bill year for more information. 

Agency Certificate = Indicates a certificate was assigned to Palm Beach County.
